title: openarm: A fully open-source humanoid arm for physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments
summary: OpenArm 是一个完全开源的人形机械臂项目，旨在为 physical AI 研究及接触丰富环境中的部署提供硬件与软件支持。

tech_highlights: Fully open-source humanoid arm hardware and software stack
Designed for contact-rich manipulation and physical AI research
Supports real-world deployment in environments requiring force-aware control
analysis.score_reason: 该项目聚焦具身智能与接触丰富操作，对机器人学习和开源硬件社区具有较高参考价值。
